basics.name: Pedro Fabrino
basics.label: Mobile Engineer | Technical Lead (iOS, React Native & Mobile Architecture)
basics.summary: Mobile Engineer & Technical Lead with 12+ years of experience engineering high-impact mobile architectures across iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), React Native, and Flutter. Proven track record leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams, designing scalable mobile frameworks using MVVM, VIPER, and MVC patterns for enterprise automotive and entertainment leaders (BMW, Disney/Apply Digital), and automating developer infrastructure. Expert in mobile performance optimization, CI/CD pipelines, and cross-functional technical strategy.

work.summary: Leading technical discovery, architecture, and sprint planning for international client applications, while driving developer platform initiatives and cross-team alignment.
highlights: Spearheaded the architecture and delivery of an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) using Terraform, Docker, and AWS for a major German automotive OEM, reducing infrastructure provisioning time by 60%
Orchestrated technical discovery, architectural blueprints, and effort estimation for 10+ enterprise mobile initiatives, achieving a 95% on-time sprint delivery rate across cross-functional teams
Mentored and directed 12+ mobile and backend engineers, establishing standardized Swift/React Native code quality guidelines and automated CI/CD workflows

work.summary: Led key mobile and tvOS development for a tier-1 entertainment client, architecting secure video streaming applications for iOS, iPadOS, and tvOS.
highlights: Architected and rewrote core tvOS & iOS media streaming applications from legacy MVC and UIKit/UIViews to MVVM and SwiftUI, improving app scalability, maintainability, and feature velocity by 35% for a global tier-1 entertainment company
Engineered secure DRM-protected video streaming pipelines for pre-release theatrical content, maintaining 99.9% playback stability across iPad, iPhone, and Apple TV devices

work.summary: Engineered high-performance cross-platform and native iOS applications using MVVM architecture with continuous delivery pipelines and junior developer mentorship.
highlights: Architected and developed core features using MVVM for high-scale enterprise apps (UOWE / Warren) with React Native and Swift, serving 500k+ active users
Reduced crash rates from >2.0% to <0.15% across production apps by introducing strict memory management and automated error tracking

work.summary: Directed mobile development teams for flagship client apps, driving technical strategy, architecture (MVVM/VIPER), and Scrum alignment.
highlights: Directed mobile architecture using MVVM and VIPER design patterns for major enterprise applications (Ticket, BMW Connected, BMW MLaptimer, BMW Mini, Livelo) in Swift and React Native, serving 1M+ active users
Onboarded and mentored 15+ engineers, establishing mobile CI/CD pipelines (Fastlane, GitHub Actions) that accelerated release cycle times by 40%
Aligned sprint goals directly with client executives and cross-functional teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies to ensure 100% transparent milestone delivery

work.summary: Built native iOS applications from concept to deployment using Objective-C, Swift, and MVC architecture.
highlights: Engineered 6+ native iOS applications from scratch (Dokter, AulaUP, VetsGo, Sabin) using Objective-C and Swift, integrating RESTful APIs and local persistence
Optimized UI layout responsiveness and resolved complex concurrency bugs across legacy Objective-C and UIKit codebases

work.summary: Selected for competitive iOS Developer Education program sponsored by Apple.
highlights: Developed multiple prototype applications for iOS exploring early Objective-C framework design and mobile UI standards
